title: BAD BAD BAD
text: BAD BAD BAD. Well, got this to make bulletproof coffee and turns out there is a small yellow strip attached to the cup on the inside that says you can't use this for hot liquids. Whats the point then? Also, it fell on the floor (empty) and the cheap plastic lid broke right away, so have not even used this once and it's already in the trash. Terrible product.

product_metadata.title: Ninja XSKDWSS24 Blenders-Accessories, 24 oz, Stainless Steel
features: Durable double-walled insulation keeps beverages colder for up to 4 hours (As compared to Ninja single-walled plastic cups when blended with ice and frozen ingredients)
Slim design fits in most car cup holders, making it an ideal commuter companion for your nutrient juices
Sip & Seal Lid for enjoying your drinks on the go
Simply attaches to Pro Extractor Blades included with your blender. The Pro Extractor Blades are able to crush through whole fruits, vegetables, nuts, seeds, and ice
BPA free, lead free, and phthalate free
description: The Ninja XSKDWSS24 24 oz. Stainless Steel Nutri Ninja with Sip & Seal Lid is a durable double-walled stainless steel that keeps beverages colder for up to 4 hours. Compatible models include: BL480, BL480D, BL481, BL482, BL486CO, BL487, BL487A, BL488W, BL490, BL491, BL492, BL492W, BL640, BL641, BL642, BL642W, BL642Z, BL680A, BL682.
